author: Papa Charlie
notes_extra: Berger 185 Jugs. Rem 700, 30 in 5 groove 1:10 Benchmark. Freebore 0.110. 0.015 off the lands. Neck tension 0.001. His May 26 post gave 2731 fps for this charge. He did not name the cartridge; the thread is .308.

author: allen529
notes_extra: 185's in the 185 Jugs thread. Mild load. 20 rounds at 300 yards. He did not name the cartridge; the thread is .308.
